summary.zh: 一座悬浮于星海的微小庇护所。绕树而行，看光芒与萤火一起呼吸。
summary.en: A tiny sanctuary adrift among the stars. Orbit a luminous tree and watch its light breathe with the fireflies.

coverAlt.zh: 深蓝星空中的悬浮岩岛，岛上生长着一棵紫色发光树，萤火围绕树冠。
coverAlt.en: A floating rock island in a dark blue starfield, with a luminous violet tree and drifting fireflies.

text.zh: 拖动绕岛，滚轮走近，方向键也能带路。
text.en: Drag to circle the island, scroll to draw near. The arrow keys know the way too.

tech.zh: 轨道相机 · 阻尼缓动 · 键盘可达

text.zh: 树冠的光与萤火同一个节奏明灭，像远处有人为你留了一盏灯。
text.en: The crown and the fireflies glow and fade to one rhythm, like a lamp someone left on for you.

tech.zh: 13,500 片实例化树叶 · 实时辉光

text.zh: 光芒由你拨动，从一夜静谧，到满树盛放。
text.en: Turn the light yourself, from a quiet night to a tree in full bloom.

tech.zh: 实时参数 · 无障碍滑块

text.zh: 开一点声音，听五个正弦音缓缓呼吸，看云从岛下流过。
text.en: Let in a little sound, five sine tones breathing slowly, and watch the clouds drift beneath the island.

tech.zh: Web Audio 合成 · 宫徵二音 · 程序化云层
tech.en: Web Audio synthesis · Two-note harmony · Procedural clouds
